title: Approved Bundle Manifest
$comment: contracts/WORK_QUEUES.md 1.0: an Approved bundle is one manifest plus its edge, node and report components. Components are never separate Integrator jobs, so the manifest is the single artifact that names them and pins their checksums.

id.description: APPROVED-<gup-id>-rNN. The GUP ID already ends in its own -rNN, so a well-formed bundle ID carries two revision suffixes: the GUP's and the bundle's. The manifest filename is this ID plus .yaml.

approves.description: The Review that approved this bundle and the GUP it approved. WORK_QUEUES rule 5: a downstream artifact consumes its input by recording the exact upstream ID and checksum.

gur_id.description: Carried through from the GUP so the source lineage stays recoverable from the bundle alone.

components.description: Every file in the bundle, each pinned by checksum. The manifest itself is not listed.

path.description: Repository-relative path. Published paths are provenance and must remain valid.

integration.description: Set once an Integration record consumes this bundle. Its presence removes the bundle from the Integrator queue.

checksum.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256, prefixed. Matches the form the Builder already writes for gur_checksum.
